decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a core hardware platform that drives consumables revenue and fits the traceability strategy, so withdrawal after about four years is unlikely.
The numbering software module is cheap to maintain and supports serialization, though it could eventually be folded into a broader software suite.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces serves a large, ongoing market need and generates recurring ink sales.
The free decoding app supports the firm's code-verification and traceability offer at low cost, but apps are often replaced by successors, as this one replaced PharmaScan.
Inline code verification is central to the firm's serialization and end-to-end traceability direction, and demand for it is growing.
The layout design software is the common operating interface across the firm's systems and underpins its digitalization strategy.
